errors.description: MATCHED PAIR GATE FAILURE. Indistinguishable from its arc sibling - both render a plain straight horizontal welt opening. The drawn discriminators are absent: the roughly twice-as-steep slope, the sharp angular V elbow turning down against the seam, and the ABSENCE of a topstitch line where the arc has one.
errors.expected: a mouth dropping about twice as steeply as the arc, ending in a hard angular V at the side seam, with no parallel topstitch inside the band
errors.actual: a plain straight horizontal welt pocket, visually identical to the arc option
errors.correction: Describe the mouth as an explicit vertex path with a sharp unrounded corner at the seam end, and state that no topstitch may appear. Shoot arc and diamond as a pair and reject unless both separate.
